description: Hand-written evaluation cases for data/sample_docs. 'reference' is a one-sentence ground-truth answer (used only by the optional RAGAS evaluation); 'expected_evidence' are verbatim phrases that must appear in the retrieved chunks; 'answer_must_contain' are short facts the answer must state. Cases with answerable=false have no supporting text in the documents on purpose. Cases with requires_semantic=true use wording that shares almost no words with the document (a paraphrase); they are SKIPPED (not passed) when only the lexical fallback embedder is active.

cases.question: How many days per week can eligible employees work remotely?
cases.reference: Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.

cases.question: When do employees become eligible for remote work?
cases.reference: Employees become eligible for remote work after completing their 90-day probation period.

cases.question: How much is the one-time home office stipend?
cases.reference: Employees receive a one-time home office stipend of 500 USD.

cases.question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense report?
cases.reference: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the date of the expense.

cases.question: Above what amount is a receipt required for an expense?
cases.reference: A receipt is required for every expense above 25 USD.

cases.question: What is the daily meal limit when travelling on business?
cases.reference: The daily meal limit is 60 USD per person when travelling on business.

cases.question: What is the minimum number of characters in a password?
cases.reference: Passwords must contain at least 14 characters.

cases.question: What is the minimum password length?
cases.reference: Passwords must contain at least 14 characters.

cases.question: How quickly must a security incident be reported?
cases.reference: A suspected security incident must be reported to the Security Operations team within 1 hour of discovery.

cases.question: How long are production database backups retained?
cases.reference: Production databases are backed up every 24 hours and the backups are retained for 35 days.

cases.question: What is the hotel nightly limit in high-cost cities?
cases.reference: Hotel stays are limited to 250 USD per night in high-cost cities such as New York, London and Tokyo.

cases.question: When can business class be booked for flights?
cases.reference: Business class may be booked for flights longer than 6 hours with approval from a vice president.

cases.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for a personal vehicle?
cases.reference: Personal vehicle mileage is reimbursed at 0.67 USD per mile.
